links.comparator_used: Existing online patient information on glaucoma surgery (webpages), not a default no-instruction prompt
links.outcome: Reading grade level of patient handouts
links.effect: Online webpages 12th grade vs ChatGPT responses 11th grade, no significant difference; the 6th-grade target was not met
links.quote: There was no difference between the reading level of online webpages (12th grade) and the reading level of ChatGPT-generated responses (11th grade), despite the ChatGPT prompts asking for simple language and a sixth grade reading level.

links.comparator_used: Manual DISCERN quality scoring of the webpages
links.outcome: Agreement between ChatGPT-based DISCERN quality scores and manual scores
links.quote: ChatGPT scored the quality of health resources with high precision ( r =0.725).
